description: NoVA Public Water System Atlas: Groundwater Islands, the Purchased-Water Network, and 47 Years of System Consolidation (SDWIS, 1979-2026) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Keystone GIS (Keystone GIS Northern Virginia GIS Research Program). Every public water system ever registered with EPA SDWIS in the nine Northern Virginia jurisdictions: 621 systems, 202 active and 409 deactivated between 1979 and 2026, with source-water type, 253 active wells, owner and system class, a 40-edge purchased-water dependency network, and 769 Safe Drinking Water Act violations spanning 1977-2026. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
